title: An Autonomous AI Security Agent for Banking: Multi-Vector Fraud and AML Detection Across Retail and Corporate Accounts
abstract: arXiv:2606.17555v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Banks face two threat families with fundamentally different detection requirements: signature-based fraud (card-not-present attacks, account takeover, ATM cloning) and behavioural financial crime (structuring, layering, mule networks, business email compromise). Static rule engines catch high-velocity events but remain blind to BEC payment redirection, session hijacking, and laundering layering, which are engineered to resemble legitimate activity at the individual level. This paper presents an autonomous AI security agent acting independently at low- and medium-risk tiers and escalating to a human analyst or compliance officer for high-risk and critical actions for retail and corporate banking using a three-component fusion architecture across two parallel event streams: transactions (card fraud, ACH/wire fraud, AML) and sessions (account takeover, hijacking, SIM-swap, insider abuse). Each stream combines an LSTM sequence mode

translated_title: 面向银行业的自主AI安全代理：覆盖零售与企业账户的多向量欺诈与反洗钱检测
translated_abstract: 银行面临着两类检测需求截然不同的威胁：基于特征签名的欺诈（如无卡交易攻击、账户盗用、ATM克隆）和行为性金融犯罪（如拆分交易、分层洗钱、骡子账户网络、商业电子邮件入侵）。静态规则引擎能够捕获高速率事件，但对于那些在个体层面被刻意伪装成合法活动的BEC支付重定向、会话劫持和洗钱分层行为却无能为力。本文提出一种面向零售与企业银行业务的自主AI安全代理，它在低、中风险层级可独立行动，而在高风险和关键操作时升级至人工分析师或合规官处理；该代理采用三组件融合架构，处理两条并行事件流：交易流（银行卡欺诈、ACH/电汇欺诈、反洗钱）和会话流（账户盗用、会话劫持、SIM卡劫持、内部人员滥用）。每条事件流结合LSTM序列模……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种面向零售与企业银行业务的自主AI安全代理，通过融合交易与会话两条并行事件流的三组件架构，在低中风险下自主处理、高风险下升级人工，实现对签名类欺诈与行为性金融犯罪（含欺诈与反洗钱）的多向量检测。
en_tdlr: The paper presents an autonomous AI security agent for retail and corporate banking that detects multi-vector fraud and AML threats across two parallel event streams (transactions and sessions) via a three-component fusion architecture, acting independently at low/medium risk and escalating high-risk cases to human analysts.
